# Alara Village by Charlene Dellosa

> Alara Village is a garden community of two-storey homes in Cavite, Philippines. The property specialist is Charlene L. Dellosa ("The Dynamic Property Specialist") of Innersparc Realty Corporation.

Website: https://alara-village.vercel.app/

## House models
- Veta: 85 sqm, 2-storey single detached home, minimum lot cut 121 sqm
- Zila: 96 sqm, 2-storey partially attached home, minimum lot cut 121 sqm
- Raya: 110 sqm, 2-storey single attached home, minimum lot cut 121 sqm
- Yana: 130 sqm, 2-storey single detached home, minimum lot cut 171 sqm
- Every home has a lanai and 2-car parking.

## Village amenities
Entrance Gate, Midpark 1, Forest Park, Midpark 2, Play Area Tri-Court, Clubhouse Pool.

## Nearby (approximate travel time)
CALAX Open Canal exit 2 to 3 min; LTO Imus District Office and Ateneo de Manila University (General Trias) 3 to 5 min; SM City General Trias 5 to 8 min; South Imus Specialist Hospital 12 to 15 min.
